name: refactor_js_callback_pyramid_to_async
description: Callback-pyramid sequential API calls -> async/await with promisify; drift broken passes the lookup id instead of the canonical user.id to the second call
prompts: loadDashboard(api, userId, callback) in dashboard.js chains three callback-style API calls (getUser -> getOrders -> getRecommendations) in a nested pyramid, with an `if (err) { callback(err); return; }` at each level. Refactor the body to async/await - promisify the api methods (node:util's promisify; bind them to `api`) and await them in sequence inside a try/catch that funnels any error to callback(err). Keep the exact data flow: getOrders is called with user.id (the id returned by getUser, which is NOT necessarily the same as the userId argument), getRecommendations with the orders, and the final callback still receives the same summary object { user, orderCount, recommendations }. Keep the function's callback-style signature (it still takes and calls `callback`).
